messages:
laura: HarborNet P1 — customers are getting intermittent 503s on re-rank. INC-5423 created. Need a short-term workaround (routing/fallback) + owners for hotpatch + CR review. Can eng-platform + eng-ml commit to a 2hr window? cc @matt @anya

matt: On it. Triage started. Do we have a minimal repro or sample logs?

laura: Pasted a sample error and stack trace below (from prod correlation id 7f3b):
```
2026-03-18T18:12:02Z ERROR request_id=7f3b code=503 model=redwood-re-rank-v2 kv_cache_miss=true queue_time_ms=74
  stack: inference/runtime/serve.go:421 -> routing/policy.go:88 -> model/runner.go:132
```

anya: Thanks. Short summary from ML: the latest quantized shard has a failure mode with long tail for certain sequences — causes backend saturation + 503 cascade. We have a candidate rollback (non-quantized shard) but that's a heavier footprint.

shrey: I can own a routing policy override to send HarborNet traffic to redwood-re-rank-v1 for up to 60m. Requires a small config change + canary (route weight). I can spin up a PR in ~45m.

kate: If we route to v1, we should adjust autoscale thresholds and avoid aggressive downscaling for that pool. I'll patch alerting and keep the oncall watch.

sasha-cs: I pinged HarborNet. Customer agreed to a temporary fallback for 30–60m if it avoids 503s. They want the change communicated before we flip.

matt: For the hotpatch (rollback candidate) I can prepare a build if ML signs off. Need @anya to confirm eval on safety/regression. I'll also open the CR and request expedited review from @sasha-cs and infra team.

anya: I can run a 100-sample eval against the redwood-re-rank-v1 candidate in ~12m and post results here. Quick sanity pass only.

shrey: PR skeleton: https://github.com/redwood-inference/routing/pull/ -- will push branch `hotfix/harbornet-routing` and include canary config: 
```yaml
- matcher: tenant == "harbornet"
  action: set_model
  params: { model: "redwood-re-rank-v1", weight: 100, ttl: 3600 }
```

deploy-bot: scheduled canary rollout for branch hotfix/harbornet-routing -> canary pool at 10% once PR merged.

oncall-bot: bridge created: https://meet.redwood/bridge/INC-5423 (oncall: kate). Use the bridge for rollback/coord calls.

laura: Action list / owners (quick):
- shrey: routing override PR + merge (ETA 45–90m)
- anya: 100-sample eval + signoff (~12m)
- matt: triage hotpatch build + open CR + expedite reviews
- kate: alert threshold patch + monitoring during rollout
- laura: customer comms + keep INC updated
- sasha-cs: acceptance from HarborNet (confirmed temporary fallback)

matt: I'll ping infra and a couple reviewers after PR is up. If we get signoff from @anya and alerts look good, we flip canary to 100% for HarborNet.

anya: eval started (will post results in thread).

shrey: starting branch work now. Will post link when ready.

laura: Thanks team — keep async updates here. If anything blocks the 2hr expectation call it out now.
